posts.zh:
dsh-native-launcher 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a75c272d687ac91636e.html
posts.en:
dsh-native-launcher is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4a75c272d687ac91636e.html
